_doc: Research agenda of the hub's autonomous agent (qpl.hub.agent). Only items with status 'approved' run. Each item is pre-registered here (hypothesis, data, script, decision rule) before it runs; editing an item after it ran does not change its recorded experiment (the config hash includes the protocol). Statuses: proposed (needs a human), approved, retired.

items.title: Halve the event short when BTC 30-day vol is above its 1-year median
items.hypothesis: New-coin short squeezes are more violent in volatile markets; halving the event short in high-vol regimes raises the v9.8 book Sharpe by >= 0.05 with no period lower.
items.rationale: Gen473 regime table: event short Sharpe -0.41 in high BTC vol vs 1.94 in low vol. FLAGGED post hoc (seen before testing); a pass still needs a human decision and out-of-sample paper evidence.

decision_rule.pass_if: book >= ref + 0.05 and all(p[i] >= pr[i] for i in range(3))

items.title: Bybit listing / delisting announcements as event shorts (R2)
items.hypothesis: Bybit delisting announcements and Bybit-first listings carry the same selling pressure as Binance's; adding them to the event short raises the book by >= 0.05 with no period lower.
items.rationale: Same mechanism as the strongest v9.8 edge (Gen468); Bybit is HyroTrader's exchange.
items.needs_user: run get_bybit_announcements.bat on the PC (Bybit blocks the cloud); the script is written and selftested (research/v99/r2_protocol.json, registered before the data exists)

decision_rule.pass_if: book >= ref + 0.05 and all(p[i] >= pr[i] for i in range(3))

items.result: FAIL: A+B book 3.228 [3.055, 3.938, 2.632] vs 3.211 [3.083, 3.849, 2.661] (+0.017, 2022 and 2025-26 lower); 224 Bybit perp-delisting events, spot titles carry no coin names

items.title: Weiss expiry at full instead of half weight in v9.8
items.hypothesis: Weiss is uncorrelated with every sleeve and earns +0.13 of book Sharpe on 1.6% of the risk; full weight raises the v9.8 book by >= 0.05 with no period lower.
items.rationale: Gen448 tested this on v9.6 (near miss, 2025-26 lower). Re-testing on a new reference is post hoc: needs a human decision.

decision_rule.pass_if: book >= ref + 0.05 and all(p[i] >= pr[i] for i in range(3))

items.title: Measure real limit-order fill rates in the dry-run bot (R1 follow-up)
items.hypothesis: Resting limits at the touch for the daily sleeves fill >= 85% within 60 minutes on Bybit, which would make the R1 central gain (+0.10) credible.
items.rationale: OHLC cannot model queue position; only real order-book interaction can. Needs the bot's market-data access on the user's PC (read-only, no orders).
items.needs_user: a read-only order-book logger on the PC (to be built); no orders are placed

items.title: User TA ideas: EMA ribbon, HMA slope (+TEMA), pin bar, slow-EMA pullback on crypto, futures, CFDs
items.hypothesis: Any of the four textbook signals adds >= 0.05 Sharpe to the crypto, futures or index-CFD book with no period lower.
items.rationale: User request 2026-10-30. Run by Claude (script outside the agent whitelist); result: 0 of 15 trials pass.
